narr: A gulf low develop along the Texas coast and moved northeast across the region. Heavy rain and severe storms occurred ahead of the low and associated cold front.
ev: Heavy rain caused Little Pine Island to go over bank full and flood streets around Pinewood Estates.
Stream gages indicated multiple bayous or ditches overflowed in China and Hampshire. Numerous roads were also flooded by several inches of rain in west Jefferson County.
